title: Add mobile responsiveness to all components
body:
Components were using fixed dimensions and spacing, causing overflow and poor UX on mobile devices (<640px viewports). ## Changes Applied mobile-first responsive design to **19 components across 8 categories**: ### Basic Components (6) - **navigation-menu**: `w-[400px]` → `w-full sm:w-[400px]` - eliminates horizontal overflow - **button-group**: `inline-flex` → `flex flex-wrap sm:inline-flex` - enables vertical stacking - **div**: `p-4` → `p-2 sm:p-4` - reduces padding on small screens - **separator**: `my-4` → `my-2 sm:my-4` - tightens vertical rhythm - **image**: added `max-w-full h-auto` defaults - prevents overflow - **span**: `px-2 py-1` → `px-1.5 py-0.5 sm:px-2 sm:py-1` - optimizes inline spacing ### Layout Components (4) - **page**: `p-6 md:p-8` → `p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8` - progressive padding scaling - **container**: all 12 padding levels now responsive (e.g., `p-2 sm:p-3 md:p-4`) - **flex**: `gap-2` → `gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 md:gap-3` - responsive gaps - **stack**: `gap-2` → `gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 md:gap-3` - responsive gaps ### Form Components (2) - **file-upload**: `p-6` → `p-4 sm:p-6` + responsive filename truncation - **form**: grid layout now mobile-first: `sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4` ### Data Display (2) - **statistic**: `p-6` → `p-4 sm:p-5 md:p-6` - card padding scales - **kbd**: `inline-flex` → `inline-flex flex-wrap` - keys wrap on narrow screens ### Navigation (1) - **header-bar**: `h-16 px-4` → `h-14 sm:h-16 px-3 sm:px-4` - shorter on mobile ### Overlay (1) - **context-menu**: `w-[300px]` → `w-full sm:w-[300px]` - full width trigger on mobile ### Complex (1) - **carousel**: slide padding `p-8` → `p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8` - responsive padding All changes use Tailwind's mobile-first breakpoint system (base → `sm:` → `md:` → `lg:`). ## Visual Comparison **Desktop (>640px)** **Mobile (375px)** Components now adapt seamlessly across viewport sizes without breaking layouts or requiring horizontal scroll.
Original prompt > 修正优化所有基础组件在手机上的显示效果
